'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**The death toll from the conflict increases to 46, with hundreds of people injured and more than 100 buildings destroyed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-56963998?piano-modal (BBC News)]
**Over 30,000 [[Kyrgyz people|Kyrgyz]] civilians are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] from the [[Batken Region]] near the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]] with [[Tajikistan]]. [https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/3418071.html (Trend News Agency)]
**The [[Ministry of the Interior (Kyrgyzstan)|Kyrgyzstan Interior Ministry]] and Tajikistan both report that the situation at the border is stable and calm. Both countries also agree to withdraw troops from the border. However, an unexploded air missile is discovered at a house in [[Batken]], [[Kyrgyzstan]], near the border. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-border-truce-holding/31234423.html (Rferl.org)] [https://news.prensa-latina.cu/?p=35697/2021/05/02/kyrgyzstan-and-tajikistan-withdraw-troops-from-conflict-zone/ (''Prensa Latina'')] [http://en.kabar.kg/news/home-of-kyrgyz-villager-in-batken-hit-by-aircraft-missile-fired-by-tajik-side/ (Kabar)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A 40-foot (12 m) trawler smuggling migrants capsized in [[San Diego Bay]], [[Mexico]], washed ashore and broke up on rocks. Three people are found to have died, and one person later died in the hospital. Around 25 people are rescued and hospitalized, including 1 in critical condition. The captain was detained. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/05/02/us/san-diego-boat-accident/index.html (CNN)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Afghanistan]]
****[[Afghanistan]] reports 166 cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the total number of cases to 60,288. [https://tolonews.com/health-171864 (TOLOnews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] reports a record 730 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 14,520. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/05/02/us-health-coronavirus-cambodia (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports a record 3,689 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 215,542. [https://m.timesofindia.com/india/record-3689-daily-covid-19-deaths-in-india-392488-more-test-positive/amp_articleshow/82351561.cms (''The Times of India'')]

****[[Malaysia]] reports its first case of the Lineage B.1.617 variant when the [[Government of Malaysia|authorities]] screen an Indian national at [[Kuala Lumpur International Airport]]. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/05/02/report-malaysia-records-first-indian-covid-19-variant/1971054 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****[[Emirate of Abu Dhabi|Abu Dhabi]] updates its travel procedures for residents and visitors who are fully vaccinated. [https://www.gulftoday.ae/news/2021/05/02/abu-dhabi-updates-travel-procedures-for-vaccinated-residents-travellers (''Gulf Today'')]

***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[Lineage B.1.617]]

**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Iran]]ian [[state media]] report a deal to release [[$]]7 billion of [[Iranian frozen assets|frozen Iranian funds]] has been reached between [[Iran]], the [[United States]], and the [[United Kingdom]] for the release of prisoners with [[Western world|Western]]-links, including [[Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe]], in which the British government has agreed to pay a [[£]]400 million debt for her release. [https://news.sky.com/story/nazanin-zaghari-ratcliffe-uk-to-pay-tehran-163400m-to-free-british-iranian-national-state-tv-reports-12293267 (Sky News)]
***The United States denies the claim that it had agreed to exchange either prisoners or money with Iran. The United Kingdom likewise denies that any definitive decision has been made in the case of Zaghari-Ratcliffe's repatriation. [https://apnews.com/article/world-news-iran-europe-middle-east-business-af8595806655db90a1204ab88f05273c (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes|2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan conflict]]
**The [[Ministry of the Interior (Kyrgyzstan)|Kyrgyzstan Interior Ministry]] launches 11 criminal probe investigations into the events on the [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|border]] with [[Tajikistan]]. [https://akipress.com/news:657681:Kyrgyz_Interior_Ministry_launches_11_criminal_probes_into_Kyrgyz-Tajik_border_events/ (AKIpress)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[Jerusalem]] District Court orders at least six families residing in the [[Sheikh Jarrah]] neighborhood in [[East Jerusalem]] to vacate their homes, following decades of litigation by [[Israeli settlement|Jewish settler]] organizations claiming they are the rightful owners of the property. [[Hamas]] condemns this ruling as "dangerous, racist behavior", threatening retaliation. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/1/what-is-happening-in-occupied-east-jerusalems-sheikh-jarrah (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/several-arab-families-in-sheikh-jarrah-in-jerusalem-face-eviction-666954 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in Canada]]
**The [[Proud Boys]] announces that they have dissolved in [[Canada]] after being labeled as a terrorist organization by the country earlier this year. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/proud-boys-canada-dissolves-itself-says-it-was-never-a-white-supremacy-group-1.5411112 (CTV News)]
*[[President of Syria|Syrian President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] signs a decree that grants amnesty and reduces sentences for prisoners ahead of an [[2021 Syrian presidential election|election on May 26]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-amnesty-offered-ahead-presidential-elections (Middle East Eye)]
*[[Istanbul]] police announce that, on Wednesday, they arrested an [[Afghans|Afghan]] man who served as a close aide to former [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] leader [[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]] and who had helped him hide in [[Syria]]'s [[Idlib Governorate]] after the group lost [[Territory of the Islamic State|its territory]] in 2019. The man lived in the [[Ataşehir]] district on the Asian side of the city. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/2/turkish-police-say-top-isil-figure-captured-in-operation (Al Jazeera)]
